title: Superlative
text: Beautiful atmosphere, the staff very helpful and polite, well-kept environments, the show was overwhelming, beautiful experience
author: samantag292

title: Amazing experience
text: We had never been to anything like this before and found it to be thoroughly entertaining and would highly recommend it.
author: BrettH1967

title: Authentic Flamenco show in Seville 10/10!
text: What a fab addition to our Seville trip... we all loved the show - such passion from all the performers!  Just incredible.  Great venue too.  Incase it's helpful, we booked the General seats which included a drink and we arrived 10 mins before the show started and got great seats (they're all pretty good seats tbh as it's a small venue).  Definitely recommend.
author: T7982AElesleyh

title: Absolutely phenomenal...
text: Absolutely phenomenal show. Worth springing for the VIP ticket so you get a good seat. The cocktail and tapa were both tasty as well. Not sure if all flamenco shows are like this one but this one was well coordinated and absolutely wonderful. Everyone on stage is so talented. Loved it!
author: MarieFrance_B

title: Great experience, highly recommended
text: Opted for the the VIP tickets, and tgought it was really worth it, came with 2 drinks each and serran ham, and cheese, then salted nuts and pork,Really immersed experience, and the musicians, singers and dancers all excellent , definitely recommend
author: gilhams09

title: Amazing dancing
text: Fabulous evening. The two main solo dancers woman and man were exceptional. The firework was breathtaking and we were seated in the middle of the stage and couldn’t keep up with the footwork
author: Ottiemax

title: Great experience!
text: The show was incredibly good. Even my 14 & 19yo boy enjoyed it. So worth it!
author: brendawP2140QI

title: Wonderful
text: Wonderful. An unmissable show that I highly recommend. Located in Tablao Las Setas in the Old Quarter.
author: Bernadete_P

title: Loved it all!
text: Great show with amazing performers.  Loved the vibe of the theater. I could listen to the guitar all night! Drinks and tapas were good.  Went with the family and kids thought it was really loud- So just a heads up if any kids are sensitive to sound.
author: J1145NLjuliec

title: Fantastic!
text: The show covered many aspects of flamenco culture. The dancers and singers interpret the emotion of the music perfectly. Highly recommended!
